SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY COALESCE(rb.return_rate_snapshot, 0) DESC, m.member_id ASC ) AS rankPosition,
m.member_id AS memberId, m.nickname AS nickname, m.profile AS profile,
COALESCE(rb.return_rate_snapshot, 0) AS returnRate, COALESCE(hq.holding_quantity, 0) AS holdingQuantity, COALESCE(pp.profit, 0) AS profit
FROM member m
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT member_id, MAX(return_rate_snapshot) AS return_rate_snapshot FROM ranking_board WHERE stock_code IS NULL AND rank_date = ( SELECT MAX(rank_date) FROM ranking_board WHERE stock_code IS NULL ) GROUP BY member_id ) rb ON rb.member_id = m.member_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.member_id, SUM(h.quantity) AS holding_quantity FROM account a JOIN holding h ON h.account_id = a.account_id WHERE h.quantity > 0 GROUP BY a.member_id ) hq ON hq.member_id = m.member_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.member_id, SUM( (CAST(s.current_price AS SIGNED) - CAST(h.avg_price AS SIGNED)) * CAST(h.quantity AS SIGNED) ) AS profit FROM account a JOIN holding h ON h.account_id = a.account_id JOIN stock s ON s.stock_code = h.stock_code GROUP BY a.member_id ) pp ON pp.member_id = m.member_id
WHERE m.member_role = 'USER'
ORDER BY rankPosition ASC
